q: 你先坐，经理现在___过来。
zh: 你先坐，经理现在就过来。
py: nǐ xiān zuò jīng lǐ xiàn zài jiù guò lái
en: Please sit down; the manager is coming over right now.
why: 现在 + 就 says 'immediately'. 又 'again', 也 'also' and 还 'still' make 现在 contradict the idea of coming right away.

q: 我昨天太累了，晚上八点___睡了。
zh: 我昨天太累了，晚上八点就睡了。
py: wǒ zuó tiān tài lèi le wǎn shàng bā diǎn jiù shuì le
en: I was so tired yesterday that I went to bed as early as eight in the evening.
why: Tiredness explains an early bedtime, so 就 and 了. 才 would imply that eight was late, which makes no sense for going to bed.

s: 我找了半天就找到手机。
s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān jiù zhǎo dào shǒu jī
zh: 我找了半天才找到手机。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào shǒu jī
en: I looked for ages before I found my phone.
why: 半天 shows long effort and there is no 了, so the adverb must be 才. 就 would suit an easy, quick find with 了.

q: 这个字很简单，我看一遍___会写了。
zh: 这个字很简单，我看一遍就会写了。
py: zhè ge zì hěn jiǎn dān wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù huì xiě le
en: This character is easy; I could write it after looking at it just once.
why: One look is little effort and the sentence ends in 了, so 就. 才 would suggest many tries, which contradicts 很简单.

q: 这本书___五块钱，很便宜。
zh: 这本书才五块钱，很便宜。
py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián hěn pián yi
en: This book is only five kuai; it's cheap.
why: 才 before a price means 'only that little', matching 很便宜. 都 would say 'even', 也 'also' and 又 'again'.

q: 她二十二岁就大学毕业___。
zh: 她二十二岁就大学毕业了。
py: tā èr shí èr suì jiù dà xué bì yè le
en: She graduated from university at just twenty-two.
why: 就 with an early age needs 了 to close the finished event. 过 would turn it into 'has graduated at some time' and 着 does not go with 毕业.

q: 老师一说，我___明白了。
zh: 老师一说，我就明白了。
py: lǎo shī yī shuō wǒ jiù míng bái le
en: As soon as the teacher spoke, I understood.
why: In 一 A 就 B, 就 is the partner of 一. 才 means 'late', the opposite of 'as soon as', and 也 and 还 do not fit this frame.

q: 这里的老师都很热情，___你有问题，___可以随时问我。
zh: 这里的老师都很热情，只要你有问题，就可以随时问我。
py: zhè lǐ de lǎo shī dōu hěn rè qíng zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu wèn tí jiù kě yǐ suí shí wèn wǒ
en: The teachers here are all friendly; as long as you have a question, you can ask me any time.
why: 只要 ... 就 says one easy condition suffices, matching 随时 'any time'. 只有 ... 才 would make the question the sole condition, which clashes with 随时.

s: 小王一下班就去健身房。
s_py: xiǎo wáng yī xià bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng
zh: 小王一下班就去健身房。
py: xiǎo wáng yī xià bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng
en: Xiao Wang goes to the gym as soon as he gets off work.
why: Habit with 一…就 takes no 了. 就 stands right before 去 after the first clause, which is the normal pattern.

src_py: xǐ shǒu jiān zài nà r
task: Say it is right over there, with 就.
zh: 洗手间就在那儿。
py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
en: The toilet is right over there.
why: 就 goes before 在, not after it. 在就那儿 would be a word-order error.

q: 只有周末，我___有时间看电影。
zh: 只有周末，我才有时间看电影。
py: zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò wǒ cái yǒu shí jiān kàn diàn yǐng
en: Only at weekends do I have time to watch films.
why: 只有 + a restricted time is answered by 才: weekends are the only time. 就 would pair with 只要, and 又 and 也 do not mean 'only then'.

q: 只有多听多说，你___能学好中文。
zh: 只有多听多说，你才能学好中文。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō tīng duō shuō nǐ cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
en: Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese well.
why: 只有 names the one necessary condition and is answered by 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果, so 就 here would mix up two patterns.

zh: 老师一讲我就懂了。
py: lǎo shī yī jiǎng wǒ jiù dǒng le
en: As soon as the teacher explained it, I understood.
why: 一 stands right before its verb 讲 and 就 right before 懂了, each after its own subject. 就 before 我 would turn it into 'only I'.

q: 现在___十点，会议要到十二点才结束，你不用着急走。
zh: 现在才十点，会议要到十二点才结束，你不用着急走。
py: xiàn zài cái shí diǎn huì yì yào dào shí èr diǎn cái jié shù nǐ bù yòng zháo jí zǒu
en: It's only ten now, and the meeting won't end until twelve, so there's no need to rush off.
why: 才 before 十点 means 'only ten, still early', which supports 不用着急. 都 would need 了 and would suggest it is late.

zh: 他七点才起床。
py: tā qī diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
en: He didn't get up until seven.
why: 才 follows the time 七点 and precedes 起床, with no 了. 才 cannot come at the end of the sentence.

zh: 你不去我就不去。
py: nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù
en: If you don't go, I won't go either.
why: The second clause is 我就不去, with 就 after the subject. 就 before 我 would mean 'only I don't go'.

q: 这个孩子五岁___会说话，家人都很着急。
zh: 这个孩子五岁才会说话，家人都很着急。
py: zhè ge hái zi wǔ suì cái huì shuō huà jiā rén dōu hěn zháo jí
en: This child didn't speak until he was five, and the family was very worried.
why: The number comes before the adverb, so it means 'not until five': 才 plus 会, with no 了. 就 would say he spoke early, but 家人都很着急 shows it was late.

src: 我到了公司，给你打电话。
src_py: wǒ dào le gōng sī gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
task: Rewrite with 一…就 to say 'as soon as'.
zh: 我一到公司就给你打电话。
py: wǒ yī dào gōng sī jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: I'll call you as soon as I get to the office.
why: 一 goes right before 到公司 and 就 right before the second action. 就 cannot come before 我 or after 给你打电话.

q: 公司___成立三个月，员工只有五个人，还需要慢慢发展。
zh: 公司才成立三个月，员工只有五个人，还需要慢慢发展。
py: gōng sī cái chéng lì sān gè yuè yuán gōng zhǐ yǒu wǔ gè rén hái xū yào màn màn fā zhǎn
en: The company was only founded three months ago and has just five staff; it needs to grow slowly.
why: 才 before 成立三个月 stresses how new it is. 又 'again', 也 'also' and 再 'once more' make no sense with a duration.

s: 要是你累了，我们才休息一会儿吧。
s_py: yào shì nǐ lèi le wǒ men cái xiū xī yī huì r ba
zh: 要是你累了，我们就休息一会儿吧。
py: yào shì nǐ lèi le wǒ men jiù xiū xī yī huì r ba
en: If you're tired, let's rest for a while.
why: 要是 'if' is answered by 就. 才 would require 只有 and does not go with a suggestion ending in 吧.

q: 你找李老师吗？我___是李老师。
zh: 你找李老师吗？我就是李老师。
py: nǐ zhǎo lǐ lǎo shī ma wǒ jiù shì lǐ lǎo shī
en: Are you looking for Teacher Li? I am Teacher Li.
why: 就 before 是 says 'precisely me, the one you're looking for'. 也 would say 'I too am Teacher Li', and 都 and 还 do not fit an identification.

s: 我们班才小王会开车。
s_py: wǒ men bān cái xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē
zh: 我们班就小王会开车。
py: wǒ men bān jiù xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē
en: In our class only Xiao Wang can drive.
why: To single out one person, use 就 (or 只有). 才 before a person does not mean 'only' and is not used this way.

q: 老师讲得很清楚，大家听一遍___明白了，没有人需要再问。
zh: 老师讲得很清楚，大家听一遍就明白了，没有人需要再问。
py: lǎo shī jiǎng dé hěn qīng chǔ dà jiā tīng yī biàn jiù míng bái le méi yǒu rén xū yào zài wèn
en: The teacher explained it clearly, so everyone understood after hearing it once and nobody needed to ask again.
why: One hearing is little effort, nobody needs to ask again, and 了 closes the clause: 就. 才 would mean it took repeated effort, the opposite.

q: 我___有十块钱，不能请你吃饭。
zh: 我就有十块钱，不能请你吃饭。
py: wǒ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián bù néng qǐng nǐ chī fàn
en: I only have ten kuai, so I can't treat you to a meal.
why: 就 before 有 and a small sum means 'only ten kuai', which explains why 不能请你. 也 would mean 'I also have ten', and 都 and 再 don't fit.

q: 你把报告改好，___经理___会签字。
zh: 你把报告改好，经理才会签字。
py: nǐ bǎ bào gào gǎi hǎo jīng lǐ cái huì qiān zì
en: Only when you've corrected the report will the manager sign it.
why: 才 sits after the subject 经理 and before 会: 经理才会签字. 才 in front of the subject is not Chinese word order.

s: 我一到家才给你打电话。
s_py: wǒ yī dào jiā cái gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
py: wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.
why: 一 A 就 B means 'immediately', but 才 means 'late', the opposite. 一 can only be completed by 就.

q: 这份报告特别复杂，小李写了三天___写好。
zh: 这份报告特别复杂，小李写了三天才写好。
py: zhè fèn bào gào tè bié fù zá xiǎo lǐ xiě le sān tiān cái xiě hǎo
en: The report is very complicated; it took Xiao Li three days to finish writing it.
why: Complicated and three days point to effort, and there is no 了 after 好: 才. 就 would need an easy task and a final 了.

q: 我___学了两个月中文，说得不太好。
zh: 我才学了两个月中文，说得不太好。
py: wǒ cái xué le liǎng gè yuè zhōng wén shuō dé bù tài hǎo
en: I've only studied Chinese for two months, so I don't speak it very well.
why: 才 before a short span means 'only two months', which explains 说得不太好. 也 'also', 又 'again' and 再 'again later' do not express 'only'.

q: 我一看到这道题___头疼。
zh: 我一看到这道题就头疼。
py: wǒ yī kàn dào zhè dào tí jiù tóu téng
en: My head starts to hurt the moment I see this problem.
why: 一…就 expresses an immediate reaction, here headache right after seeing the problem. 才 would mean 'not until', and 也 and 还 do not fit.

q: 办公室里的同事都下班了，___我一个人还在加班。
zh: 办公室里的同事都下班了，就我一个人还在加班。
py: bàn gōng shì lǐ de tóng shì dōu xià bān le jiù wǒ yí gè rén hái zài jiā bān
en: All my colleagues in the office have gone home; only I am still working overtime.
why: 就 in front of 我一个人 marks 'only me' after everyone else left. 也 would mean I'm also working, which clashes with 都下班了; 都 and 又 do not fit.

s: 我才学了三个月英语，还听不懂电影。
s_py: wǒ cái xué le sān gè yuè yīng yǔ hái tīng bù dǒng diàn yǐng
zh: 我才学了三个月英语，还听不懂电影。
py: wǒ cái xué le sān gè yuè yīng yǔ hái tīng bù dǒng diàn yǐng
en: I've only studied English for three months and still can't understand films.
why: 才 meaning 'only' before a short span may be followed by 了 after the verb, since 了 here marks the duration so far. The 'not until' rule does not apply.

zh: 就小李一个人没交作业。
py: jiù xiǎo lǐ yí gè rén méi jiāo zuò yè
en: Xiao Li is the only one who didn't hand in his homework.
why: 就 stands directly before the person it limits, at the head of the sentence. After 没 it would not single him out.

s: 只要你肯学，就一定能学会。
s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ kěn xué jiù yí dìng néng xué huì
zh: 只要你肯学，就一定能学会。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ kěn xué jiù yí dìng néng xué huì
en: As long as you're willing to study, you'll definitely be able to learn it.
why: 只要 is answered by 就, and 就 stands before 一定 and 能. The adverbs 一定 and 能 do not need 才.

q: 你不是在找我们的教室吗？这儿___是。
zh: 你不是在找我们的教室吗？这儿就是。
py: nǐ bú shì zài zhǎo wǒ men de jiào shì ma zhè r jiù shì
en: Aren't you looking for our classroom? This is it, right here.
why: 就 before 是 says 'precisely this place'. 也 would say 'this is also one', which does not answer the search, and 都 and 又 do not fit.

q: 他四十岁才结婚___，所以孩子还很小。
zh: 他四十岁才结婚，所以孩子还很小。
py: tā sì shí suì cái jié hūn suǒ yǐ hái zi hái hěn xiǎo
en: He didn't marry until he was forty, so his children are still small.
why: 才 'not until' stays without 了; 了 goes with 就 (四十岁就结婚了 would mean marrying early). 着 does not go with 结婚 either.

src_py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn jiù dào le
task: Say it was late: he did not arrive until ten.
zh: 他昨天十点才到。
py: tā zuó tiān shí diǎn cái dào
en: He didn't arrive until ten yesterday.
why: Switching to 才 'late' removes 了. 才 follows the time phrase and precedes 到.

q: 请问洗手间在哪儿？你看，洗手间___在那儿。
zh: 请问洗手间在哪儿？你看，洗手间就在那儿。
py: qǐng wèn xǐ shǒu jiān zài nǎ r nǐ kàn xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
en: Excuse me, where is the toilet? It's right over there.
why: 就 before 在 points at the spot: 'right over there'. 也 would be 'also over there', and 都 and 再 do not answer a where-question.

q: 如果明天下雨，我们___不去公园了。
zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去公园了。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù gōng yuán le
en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the park.
why: 如果 is answered by 就 in the result clause: if X, then Y. 才 would turn it into a hard-won result, and 又 means 'again'.

s: 他才三岁，就会背很多古诗了。
s_py: tā cái sān suì jiù huì bèi hěn duō gǔ shī le
zh: 他才三岁，就会背很多古诗了。
py: tā cái sān suì jiù huì bèi hěn duō gǔ shī le
en: He's only three, yet he can already recite many old poems.
why: Two uses in one sentence: 才 before the age means 'only three', and 就 ... 了 marks how early the ability is. Both are correct.

q: 她___三岁，还不会自己吃饭。
zh: 她才三岁，还不会自己吃饭。
py: tā cái sān suì hái bú huì zì jǐ chī fàn
en: She's only three and can't feed herself yet.
why: 才 right before an age means 'only, that's young'. 都 would need 了 and a different mood; 也 and 又 mean 'also' and 'again', not 'only'.

q: 只有把基础打好，你以后___能学得更快。
zh: 只有把基础打好，你以后才能学得更快。
py: zhǐ yǒu bǎ jī chǔ dǎ hǎo nǐ yǐ hòu cái néng xué dé gèng kuài
en: Only if you build a solid foundation can you learn faster later.
why: 只有 is answered by 才: a solid foundation is the one necessary condition. 就 would pair with 只要, and 再 and 还 do not link a condition to its result.

q: 这个项目必须由经理决定，只有他同意，我们___能开始。
zh: 这个项目必须由经理决定，只有他同意，我们才能开始。
py: zhè ge xiàng mù bì xū yóu jīng lǐ jué dìng zhǐ yǒu tā tóng yì wǒ men cái néng kāi shǐ
en: This project must be decided by the manager; only if he agrees can we start.
why: 只有 is answered by 才: his consent is the one necessary condition. 就 would answer 只要 or 如果, and 也 would add 'also'.

zh: 只有多练习才能说得好。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí cái néng shuō dé hǎo
en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.
why: 只有 opens the condition and 才 stands before 能 in the result clause. 就 would pair with 只要 instead.

s: 昨天会开到十一点才结束。
s_py: zuó tiān huì kāi dào shí yì diǎn cái jié shù
zh: 昨天会开到十一点才结束。
py: zuó tiān huì kāi dào shí yì diǎn cái jié shù
en: Yesterday's meeting didn't end until eleven.
why: 才 after 十一点 marks a late finish, and 了 is not needed with this 'not until' use. Here 才 and 到 work together.

q: 昨天会议九点开始，小王九点半___到。
zh: 昨天会议九点开始，小王九点半才到。
py: zuó tiān huì yì jiǔ diǎn kāi shǐ xiǎo wáng jiǔ diǎn bàn cái dào
en: Yesterday the meeting started at nine, and Xiao Wang didn't arrive until half past nine.
why: Half past nine is after the start, so he was late: 才, no 了. 就 needs an early time and 了, which would contradict the contrast clause.

q: 你要找的那份合同___在你左边的文件夹里，打开看看吧。
zh: 你要找的那份合同就在你左边的文件夹里，打开看看吧。
py: nǐ yào zhǎo de nà fèn hé tóng jiù zài nǐ zuǒ biān de wén jiàn jiā lǐ dǎ kāi kàn kàn ba
en: The contract you're looking for is right there in the folder on your left; open it and see.
why: 就 before 在 pinpoints 'right there', matching the instruction to open the folder. 也 would say it is also there, and 都 and 又 do not fit.

s: 就我一个人没带词典。
s_py: jiù wǒ yí gè rén méi dài cí diǎn
zh: 就我一个人没带词典。
py: jiù wǒ yí gè rén méi dài cí diǎn
en: I'm the only one who didn't bring a dictionary.
why: Placing 就 before the person it limits is correct and means 'only me'. It looks wrong because English 'then' sits in front, but here it is the 'only' 就.

zh: 如果明天下雨我们就不去了。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù le
en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
why: The condition comes first, then the subject 我们, then 就 before 不去. 就 cannot come before 我们, which would mean 'only we'.

q: 只要你把作业交上来，老师___不会批评你。
zh: 只要你把作业交上来，老师就不会批评你。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng lái lǎo shī jiù bú huì pī píng nǐ
en: As long as you hand in your homework, the teacher won't criticise you.
why: 只要 says handing it in is enough, so the result takes 就. 才 would need 只有, and 也 and 又 do not answer 只要.

q: 今天开会，___小李没来，其他人都到了。
zh: 今天开会，就小李没来，其他人都到了。
py: jīn tiān kāi huì jiù xiǎo lǐ méi lái qí tā rén dōu dào le
en: At today's meeting only Xiao Li was absent; everyone else was there.
why: 就 in front of 小李 singles out the one absentee. 也 would say Xiao Li was also absent, but 其他人都到了 makes him the only one.

q: 如果天气好，___我们___去爬山。
zh: 如果天气好，我们就去爬山。
py: rú guǒ tiān qì hǎo wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
en: If the weather's nice, we'll go hiking.
why: 就 follows the subject 我们 and sits right before 去: 我们就去. 就我们去 would mean 'only we are going', not 'then we'll go'.

s: 老板十点才到，大家八点就来了。
s_py: lǎo bǎn shí diǎn cái dào dà jiā bā diǎn jiù lái le
zh: 老板十点才到，大家八点就来了。
py: lǎo bǎn shí diǎn cái dào dà jiā bā diǎn jiù lái le
en: The boss didn't arrive until ten, but everyone had come as early as eight.
why: The contrast is deliberate. 才 (no 了) marks the boss as late and 就 ... 了 marks the others as early, so both are correct.

q: 现在___七点，你再睡一会儿吧。
zh: 现在才七点，你再睡一会儿吧。
py: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn nǐ zài shuì yī huì r ba
en: It's only seven o'clock now, so sleep a little longer.
why: 才 before a clock time says 'only seven, still early', which supports 再睡一会儿. 都 would say 'it's already seven', the opposite message; 也 and 又 do not mean 'only'.

s: 我是就李老师。
s_py: wǒ shì jiù lǐ lǎo shī
zh: 我就是李老师。
py: wǒ jiù shì lǐ lǎo shī
en: I am Teacher Li.
why: 就 must come before 是, never after it. 我是就 is not possible Chinese.

q: 他一进门，___大家___安静了。
zh: 他一进门，大家就安静了。
py: tā yī jìn mén dà jiā jiù ān jìng le
en: The moment he came in, everyone fell quiet.
why: In 一 A 就 B the 就 follows the second subject 大家, right before 安静. 就大家 would mean 'only everyone', which is not the 'as soon as' meaning.

q: 我们公司八点上班，他十点___到公司。
zh: 我们公司八点上班，他十点才到公司。
py: wǒ men gōng sī bā diǎn shàng bān tā shí diǎn cái dào gōng sī
en: Our company starts at eight, but he didn't get to the office until ten.
why: Ten o'clock is two hours after the start, so the speaker sees it as late: 才, with no 了. 就 would need an early time and a final 了.

q: 我___去过一次北京，别的城市都没去过。
zh: 我就去过一次北京，别的城市都没去过。
py: wǒ jiù qù guò yī cì běi jīng bié de chéng shì dōu méi qù guò
en: I've only been to Beijing once and have never been to any other city.
why: 就 before the verb with 一次 means 'just once', followed by 别的城市都没去过. 又 and 再 mean 'again', and 都 would contradict 一次.

zh: 他一喝酒就脸红。
py: tā yī hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng
en: His face goes red whenever he drinks.
why: The habit pattern is Subject + 一 + verb + 就 + result. 一 cannot come before the pronoun 他, and 就 must follow 喝酒, not precede it.

s: 只有多听多说，你就能学好中文。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu duō tīng duō shuō nǐ jiù néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
zh: 只有多听多说，你才能学好中文。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō tīng duō shuō nǐ cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
en: Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese well.
why: 只有 expresses a necessary condition and is answered by 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

q: 要是你明天有空，我___带你去公司看看。
zh: 要是你明天有空，我就带你去公司看看。
py: yào shì nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng wǒ jiù dài nǐ qù gōng sī kàn kàn
en: If you're free tomorrow, I'll take you to see the company.
why: 要是 'if' is answered by 就 in the result clause. 才 would need 只有, and 又 and 都 do not complete a conditional.

q: 我们班___小王会开车，其他人都不会。
zh: 我们班就小王会开车，其他人都不会。
py: wǒ men bān jiù xiǎo wáng huì kāi chē qí tā rén dōu bú huì
en: In our class only Xiao Wang can drive; everyone else can't.
why: 就 before the person singles him out: 'only Xiao Wang'. 也 would add him to a group and 都 would mean everyone can drive, against 其他人都不会.

q: 小王昨天十点才回家___，没吃晚饭。
zh: 小王昨天十点才回家，没吃晚饭。
py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān shí diǎn cái huí jiā méi chī wǎn fàn
en: Xiao Wang didn't get home until ten yesterday and skipped dinner.
why: 才 'not until' is not followed by 了. 过 would mean 'has been home before', which does not fit the specific time yesterday.

q: 经理一走进办公室，大家___安静下来了。
zh: 经理一走进办公室，大家就安静下来了。
py: jīng lǐ yī zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì dà jiā jiù ān jìng xià lái le
en: As soon as the manager walked into the office, everyone fell quiet.
why: 一 A 就 B: everyone went quiet right at his entrance. 才 would mean they stayed noisy until later, and 还 and 又 add nothing to 一.

s: 作业写完了，你能才看电视。
s_py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ néng cái kàn diàn shì
zh: 作业写完了，你才能看电视。
py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ cái néng kàn diàn shì
en: You can watch TV only after your homework is done.
why: 才 is an adverb that must stand before the modal 能. Putting it after 能 breaks the word order.

s: 洗手间在就那儿。
s_py: xǐ shǒu jiān zài jiù nà r
zh: 洗手间就在那儿。
py: xǐ shǒu jiān jiù zài nà r
en: The toilet is right over there.
why: 就 is an adverb and must come before 在. It cannot be placed between 在 and the place.

q: 经理三点就走___，没等我们开完会。
zh: 经理三点就走了，没等我们开完会。
py: jīng lǐ sān diǎn jiù zǒu le méi děng wǒ men kāi wán huì
en: The manager left as early as three and didn't wait for us to finish the meeting.
why: The leaving is a finished past event, and 就 pairs with 了. 过 would be about experience; 着 would describe a state of walking, which is wrong for 走.

q: 昨天作业太多，我写到十二点___睡。
zh: 昨天作业太多，我写到十二点才睡。
py: zuó tiān zuò yè tài duō wǒ xiě dào shí èr diǎn cái shuì
en: There was too much homework yesterday, so I didn't go to bed until twelve.
why: Midnight after too much homework is late, and 睡 has no 了: 才. 就 would suit an early bedtime with 了.

q: 你等一下，我马上___来。
zh: 你等一下，我马上就来。
py: nǐ děng yí xià wǒ mǎ shàng jiù lái
en: Hold on, I'll be right there.
why: 马上 + 就 means 'right away'. 又 means 'again', 也 means 'also' and 还 means 'still'; none of them combine with 马上.

zh: 作业写完了你才能看电视。
py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ cái néng kàn diàn shì
en: You can watch TV only after your homework is done.
why: 才 sits before the modal 能, after 你 and the condition. It cannot be moved to the front or after 看电视.

q: 作业写完了，___你___能看电视。
zh: 作业写完了，你才能看电视。
py: zuò yè xiě wán le nǐ cái néng kàn diàn shì
en: You can watch TV only after your homework is done.
why: 才 follows the subject 你 and stands before the modal 能. It cannot sit in front of 你 the way English 'only then' can.

q: 你不去，___我___不去。
zh: 你不去，我就不去。
py: nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù
en: If you're not going, then I'm not going either.
why: The result clause is 我就不去: 就 stands after the subject, before the verb. 就我 would mean 'only I', which does not give the 'then' meaning.

q: 只要你同意，___我___可以帮你。
zh: 只要你同意，我就可以帮你。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ tóng yì wǒ jiù kě yǐ bāng nǐ
en: As long as you agree, I can help you.
why: 就 goes after 我 and before the modal 可以. Putting 就 before 我 would say 'only I can help you', which changes the meaning.

s: 这本书五块钱才，很便宜。
s_py: zhè běn shū wǔ kuài qián cái hěn pián yi
zh: 这本书才五块钱，很便宜。
py: zhè běn shū cái wǔ kuài qián hěn pián yi
en: This book is only five kuai; it's cheap.
why: 才 meaning 'only' goes directly before the amount. It can't follow the price at the end of the clause.

q: 我今天七点就到学校___，教室里还没有人。
zh: 我今天七点就到学校了，教室里还没有人。
py: wǒ jīn tiān qī diǎn jiù dào xué xiào le jiào shì lǐ hái méi yǒu rén
en: I got to school as early as seven today, and there is nobody in the classroom yet.
why: One finished arrival with 就 takes 了. 过 says 'have been there before' and 着 describes a continuing state; neither reports today's arrival.

q: 他昨天晚上___十一点___回家。
zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才回家。
py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng shí yì diǎn cái huí jiā
en: He didn't get home until eleven last night.
why: The time phrase 十一点 comes first and 才 follows it, right before 回家. 才十一点 would mean 'only eleven' as the time itself.

s: 我们要找的李老师就在楼上。
s_py: wǒ men yào zhǎo de lǐ lǎo shī jiù zài lóu shàng
zh: 我们要找的李老师就在楼上。
py: wǒ men yào zhǎo de lǐ lǎo shī jiù zài lóu shàng
en: Teacher Li, who we're looking for, is right upstairs.
why: 就 stands before 在 and means 'right there'. After 在 it would be ungrammatical.

q: 他一喝酒___脸红，所以从来不喝。
zh: 他一喝酒就脸红，所以从来不喝。
py: tā yī hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng suǒ yǐ cóng lái bù hē
en: He goes red whenever he drinks, so he never drinks.
why: 一 A 就 B also states a habit: every time he drinks, his face reddens. 才 would add a delay, and 也 and 还 do not link a cause and result.

q: 公司里___他一个人会说日语，所以翻译都找他。
zh: 公司里就他一个人会说日语，所以翻译都找他。
py: gōng sī lǐ jiù tā yí gè rén huì shuō rì yǔ suǒ yǐ fān yì dōu zhǎo tā
en: Only he in the company speaks Japanese, so everyone asks him to translate.
why: 就 in front of 他一个人 limits the ability to him alone, which is why everyone asks him. 也 and 还 add people; 都 cannot go before a single person.

s: 你不把作业写完，我就不让你出去玩。
s_py: nǐ bù bǎ zuò yè xiě wán wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ chū qù wán
zh: 你不把作业写完，我就不让你出去玩。
py: nǐ bù bǎ zuò yè xiě wán wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ chū qù wán
en: If you don't finish your homework, I won't let you go out to play.
why: 就 follows 我 and comes before 不让, as the result of the 不 condition. It does not mean 'only I'.

q: 只要你努力，你___能学好。
zh: 只要你努力，你就能学好。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì nǐ jiù néng xué hǎo
en: As long as you work hard, you can learn it well.
why: 只要 'as long as' says the condition is enough, so it is answered by 就. 才 belongs to 只有, the only-if condition.

s: 只有你同意，我才去。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ cái qù
zh: 只有你同意，我才去。
py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ cái qù
en: I'll go only if you agree.
why: 只有 pairs with 才, which comes after the second subject. The 了-free form is right because this is a condition, not a finished event.

s: 他一喝酒才脸红。
s_py: tā yī hē jiǔ cái liǎn hóng
zh: 他一喝酒就脸红。
py: tā yī hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng
en: His face goes red whenever he drinks.
why: In 一 A 就 B the second verb needs 就. 才 means 'late' and cannot answer 一.

q: 他从小爱读书，八岁___读完了《西游记》。
zh: 他从小爱读书，八岁就读完了《西游记》。
py: tā cóng xiǎo ài dú shū bā suì jiù dú wán le xī yóu jì
en: He loved reading from childhood and had already finished Journey to the West at eight.
why: Reading a long novel at eight, after loving books from small, is early and impressive: 就 with 了. 才 would mean eight was late for it.

q: 经理说十点开会，同事们九点___来了。
zh: 经理说十点开会，同事们九点就来了。
py: jīng lǐ shuō shí diǎn kāi huì tóng shì men jiǔ diǎn jiù lái le
en: The manager said the meeting is at ten, and my colleagues came as early as nine.
why: Nine is an hour before the meeting, so early: 就 plus 了. 才 would say they arrived late, but nine is not late for a ten o'clock meeting.

src: 只要你多练习，就能说好。
src_py: zhǐ yào nǐ duō liàn xí jiù néng shuō hǎo
task: Change it to 'only if' with 只有.
zh: 只有你多练习才能说好。
py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ duō liàn xí cái néng shuō hǎo
en: Only if you practise a lot can you speak well.
why: 只有 changes the pair from 只要 … 就 to 只有 … 才. 就 must be replaced; leaving 就 would mix the two patterns.

q: 学生们一听到下课铃响，___马上跑出了教室。
zh: 学生们一听到下课铃响，就马上跑出了教室。
py: xué shēng men yī tīng dào xià kè líng xiǎng jiù mǎ shàng pǎo chū le jiào shì
en: As soon as the students heard the bell, they ran out of the classroom at once.
why: 一 + 听到 is answered by 就 before the next action, and 马上 already confirms immediacy. 才 would say they waited, and 也 and 又 do not complete 一.

q: 因为系统一直出问题，我们改了一个星期，客户的资料___整理完。
zh: 因为系统一直出问题，我们改了一个星期，客户的资料才整理完。
py: yīn wèi xì tǒng yì zhí chū wèn tí wǒ men gǎi le yí gè xīng qī kè hù de zī liào cái zhěng lǐ wán
en: Because the system kept breaking, it took us a week of fixes before the client's files were sorted out.
why: 一直出问题 and a whole week show it was hard-won, and 整理完 has no 了: 才. 就 would need a quick, easy job.

zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才回家。
py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng shí yì diǎn cái huí jiā
en: He didn't get home until eleven last night.
why: 才 follows the time phrase it comments on and comes right before 回家. The time may come before or after 他, but 才 may not precede it.

q: 老师一讲，我就听懂___。
zh: 老师一讲，我就听懂了。
py: lǎo shī yī jiǎng wǒ jiù tīng dǒng le
en: As soon as the teacher explained it, I understood.
why: A single completed event after 一…就 takes 了: 听懂了. 过 would mean 'have understood before' and 着 cannot follow a result like 懂.

zh: 只要你努力我们就能赢。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì wǒ men jiù néng yíng
en: As long as you work hard, we can win.
why: 只要 clause first, then 我们, then 就 before the modal 能. 就 cannot precede 我们 without changing the meaning to 'only we'.

q: 电影七点开始，他六点半___到了。
zh: 电影七点开始，他六点半就到了。
py: diàn yǐng qī diǎn kāi shǐ tā liù diǎn bàn jiù dào le
en: The film starts at seven, and he was already there by half past six.
why: Arriving at 6:30 for a 7:00 film is early, and the final 了 marks a finished event: 就 ... 了. 才 would mean he was late, which clashes with the contrast clause.

q: 虽然路上堵车，但是司机很熟悉这一带，二十分钟___把我们送到了机场。
zh: 虽然路上堵车，但是司机很熟悉这一带，二十分钟就把我们送到了机场。
py: suī rán lù shàng dǔ chē dàn shì sī jī hěn shú xī zhè yī dài èr shí fēn zhōng jiù bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le jī chǎng
en: Although the traffic was bad, the driver knew the area well and got us to the airport in just twenty minutes.
why: 虽然 sets up a delay, and 但是 turns it round: twenty minutes is quick. 就 with 了 fits. 才 would carry on the idea of a slow trip.

q: 这份报告不难，小李两个小时___写好了。
zh: 这份报告不难，小李两个小时就写好了。
py: zhè fèn bào gào bù nán xiǎo lǐ liǎng gè xiǎo shí jiù xiě hǎo le
en: The report isn't hard; Xiao Li finished writing it in just two hours.
why: The report is easy and two hours is short, so 就 with 了. 才 would imply a long, hard job, which 不难 rules out.

task: Say he came already at eight, earlier than expected (use 就).
zh: 他八点就来了。
py: tā bā diǎn jiù lái le
en: He came as early as eight.
why: 就 follows the time 八点 and stays before 来, and 了 stays at the end. 就 must not start the sentence or follow 来了.

q: 我一到公司___给你发邮件。
zh: 我一到公司就给你发邮件。
py: wǒ yī dào gōng sī jiù gěi nǐ fā yóu jiàn
en: I'll email you as soon as I get to the office.
why: 一到公司 sets the trigger and the reply pattern is 就 + verb. 才 would mean 'only then', a delay, and 也 and 还 cannot complete 一.

q: 他昨天晚上十一点才睡___，今天起不来。
zh: 他昨天晚上十一点才睡，今天起不来。
py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng shí yì diǎn cái shuì jīn tiān qǐ bù lái
en: He didn't go to bed until eleven last night, so he can't get up today.
why: 才 meaning 'not until' takes no 了 even though the event is over. 了 belongs with 就, not with 才. 过 would mean 'has ever slept', which makes no sense.

q: 她还没毕业，公司就给她发___录用通知。
zh: 她还没毕业，公司就给她发了录用通知。
py: tā hái méi bì yè gōng sī jiù gěi tā fā le lù yòng tōng zhī
en: She hadn't even graduated when the company had already sent her an offer letter.
why: 就 marks how early this was, and the sending is one finished act with an object, so 了 follows 发. 过 would suggest she had received one before; 着 fits no sending.

q: 你___不告诉我，我___没办法帮你。
zh: 你如果不告诉我，我就没办法帮你。
py: nǐ rú guǒ bù gào sù wǒ wǒ jiù méi bàn fǎ bāng nǐ
en: If you don't tell me, I have no way to help you.
why: 如果 pairs with 就 for a plain 'if ... then'. 只要 ... 才 and 只有 ... 就 mix the two condition words with the wrong adverb; 因为 ... 所以 gives a cause, not a condition.

q: 他___五岁，已经会用电脑了。
zh: 他才五岁，已经会用电脑了。
py: tā cái wǔ suì yǐ jīng huì yòng diàn nǎo le
en: He's only five, yet he already knows how to use a computer.
why: 才 + age = 'only five', setting up the surprise of 已经. 也 would mean 'also five' and 又 and 再 mean 'again'.

q: 这篇课文太难了，老师讲了三遍，我___听懂。
zh: 这篇课文太难了，老师讲了三遍，我才听懂。
py: zhè piān kè wén tài nán le lǎo shī jiǎng le sān biàn wǒ cái tīng dǒng
en: This text was so hard that I only understood it after the teacher explained it three times.
why: 太难了 and three explanations show effort, and there is no 了: 才. 就 would suit one explanation and an easy text.
